CheckTitle: Ensure Phishing-Resistant MFA Is Enforced for SaaS Administrators and Privileged Accounts
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Assessor review (the automated check is switched off)
Description: Administrators and privileged accounts should authenticate with phishing-resistant factors (FIDO2/WebAuthn security keys, passkeys or passwordless). SMS and email OTP should be disabled for them.
Risk: Privileged accounts are high-value targets; OTP-style factors can be phished or relayed.
AuditProcedure: Determine whether the environment uses OCI IAM natively or an external IdP for MFA.
Security Console > User Categories > Two-Factor Authentication: privileged categories have MFA enabled with only phishing-resistant factors.
Without the upgrade: confirm the external IdP enforces it for privileged accounts.
Test a sign-in with a privileged account.

Steps: Enable MFA for administrator/privileged categories and allow only phishing-resistant factors.
Have administrators enroll a FIDO2 key or passkey and remove weaker factors from their accounts.

DefaultValue: Not enforced by default after the identity upgrade.
Notes: Manual control. An automated check exists in the code but is switched off; the assessor reviews this control with the audit procedure.
